mapper.select: SELECT ID, TARGET_NAME, DELETE_MODE, TARGET_TYPE, BASE_PATH, FILE_PATTERN, FILE_EXTENSION, MIN_AGE_DAYS, MIN_SIZE_BYTES, CASE WHEN ENABLED = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS ENABLED, DESCRIPTION, REG_DT FROM TB_STORAGE_DELETE_TARGET ORDER BY DELETE_MODE ASC, TARGET_TYPE ASC, ID ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_STORAGE_DELETE_TARGET ( TARGET_NAME, DELETE_MODE, TARGET_TYPE, BASE_PATH, FILE_PATTERN, FILE_EXTENSION, MIN_AGE_DAYS, MIN_SIZE_BYTES, ENABLED, DESCRIPTION ) VALUES ( #{targetName}, #{deleteMode}, #{targetType}, #{basePath}, #{filePattern}, #{fileExtension}, #{minAgeDays}, #{minSizeBytes}, CASE WHEN #{enabled} = TRUE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, #{description} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_STORAGE_DELETE_TARGET SET TARGET_NAME = #{targetName}, DELETE_MODE = #{deleteMode}, TARGET_TYPE = #{targetType}, BASE_PATH = #{basePath}, FILE_PATTERN = #{filePattern}, FILE_EXTENSION = #{fileExtension}, MIN_AGE_DAYS = #{minAgeDays}, MIN_SIZE_BYTES = #{minSizeBytes}, ENABLED = CASE WHEN #{enabled} = TRUE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, DESCRIPTION = #{description} WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT ID, FILE_TYPE_NAME, FILE_EXTENSION, RETENTION_DAYS, CASE WHEN ENABLED = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS ENABLED, DESCRIPTION, REG_DT, UPD_DT FROM TB_STORAGE_RETENTION_POLICY ORDER BY FILE_EXTENSION ASC, ID ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_STORAGE_RETENTION_POLICY ( FILE_TYPE_NAME, FILE_EXTENSION, RETENTION_DAYS, ENABLED, DESCRIPTION ) VALUES ( #{fileTypeName}, #{fileExtension}, #{retentionDays}, CASE WHEN #{enabled} = TRUE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, #{description} )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_STORAGE_RETENTION_POLICY SET RETENTION_DAYS = #{retentionDays}, ENABLED = CASE WHEN #{enabled} = TRUE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, UPD_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{id}
